scope.it: 55 schede selezionate: sistemi distribuiti, app mobili, runtime, server, riferimenti e ricerca. Criteri uniformi e fonti primarie; censimento ampio ma non esaustivo, senza graduatoria universale.
scope.en: 55 selected entries across distributed systems, mobile apps, runtimes, serving, baselines and research. Uniform criteria and primary sources; broad but non-exhaustive coverage, without a universal ranking.

projects.name: NodeLift
projects.origin: Fabrizio Degni, Italy; this project.
projects.stage: 0.2.1 experimental prerelease.
projects.license: MIT; native dependencies retain their licenses.
projects.architecture: Phone drafts candidate tokens; the host verifies greedily with a pinned llama.cpp core and bounded fallback.
projects.host: macOS M3 Max measured; portable host paths require qualification.
projects.android: Native ARM64 CPU worker built; physical native drafting not yet qualified.
projects.ios: Metal/CPU companion built unsigned; physical installation pending.
projects.mobile_compute: Implemented draft worker; Xiaomi evidence currently covers network/protocol only.
projects.capacity: No target-weight sharding or shared RAM pool in 0.2.1.
projects.single_chat: 60 frozen local runs: paired median speedup 0.425–0.719×; all 48 output pairs matched. No physical-phone speedup.
projects.transport: Pinned TLS; prefix/epoch leases; bounded deadlines.
projects.api: Restricted OpenAI-style gateway; LM Studio SDK handler tested, full plugin runtime pending.
projects.security: Separate admin/client keys; TLS pinning; local trust boundary. No independent security certification.
projects.evidence: Real-weight controls, public raw runs, 29 native checks; TLS node emulated locally.
projects.limitations: Greedy only; hybrid architectures rejected; thermal/battery/native phone trials pending.
projects.lesson: Keep host-only default until end-to-end benefit is measured against a strong local baseline.

projects.name: DistAI
projects.origin: Maintainer geography not established in the reviewed primary sources.
projects.stage: Source available; not independently qualified here.
projects.architecture: llama.cpp RPC layer offload plus Android workers and request scheduling.
projects.android: Native CPU worker.
projects.ios: Not documented in the reviewed sources.
projects.mobile_compute: Yes: model layers and independent jobs.
projects.capacity: Yes: distributed layer placement.
projects.single_chat: Capacity and queued throughput benefits do not imply faster single-chat decoding.
projects.security: Underlying RPC trust boundary needs isolation.
projects.evidence: NodeLift inspected 37 preserved source files and recalculated published benchmark data; no hardware replication.
projects.limitations: Recomputed queued throughput comparison is about 1.57× against the batched baseline, not the larger sequential comparison.
projects.lesson: Always include a batched local baseline and actual output lengths.

projects.ios: Not documented in the reviewed sources.

projects.capacity: Yes: BigBrain model partitioning.

projects.api: OpenAI/Ollama-compatible API; fleet UI and monitoring.
projects.security: No TLS documented; gateway API keys are optional, admin tokens supported, node protocol unauthenticated in v0.
projects.evidence: Author-reported five-phone tests; freeze/failover drills also use redroid emulation.
projects.limitations: Emulated reliability drills are not physical thermal endurance tests; no iOS worker documented.
projects.lesson: Separate routing throughput, model capacity and thermal-aware phone placement.

projects.limitations: Apple ecosystem; hardware/kernel and OS requirements apply.
